# Results 2026-10-22 — post-hardening run @ `a4b1e34` (+ testdata/ move)

Build: `a4b1e34` "harden decoding and fix metadata accounting" plus working-tree
file moves (all fixtures -> `testdata/`). Same benches as `2026-10-22_f1a872c.md`
for comparability. All tracks recovered exact (bit-exact, or audio-exact for
FLAC->PCM kinds). `single` = per-file .flq sizes from the `1856cdf` sweep
(`single.csv`) — fixed denominator across runs.

## Per-file: testdata/ fixtures (`flq bench <file>`)

| File | Kind | In -> .flq | % | Enc (heap) | Dec (heap) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| birds_singing.wav | wav f64→f32 2ch 44.1k | 18,394,548 -> 6,784,665 B | 36.9% | 3.1 s (308 MiB) | 0.14 s (112 MiB) |
| frogs_croaking.wav | wav i16 2ch 48k | 2,506,428 -> 1,265,762 B | 50.5% | 1.2 s (134 MiB) | 0.05 s (18 MiB) |
| v2_a.wav | wav i16 2ch 44.1k | 240,044 -> 130,989 B | 54.6% | 0.2 s (17 MiB) | 0.003 s |
| v2_b.wav | wav i16 2ch 44.1k | 240,044 -> 113,831 B | 47.4% | 0.2 s (17 MiB) | 0.003 s |

(Rows for 4 copyrighted fixtures were dropped when the files were removed
from the repo; they measured 13.8–21.4% for the two WAVs and 83.5–88.1%
for the two MP3s.)

## Multi-track: 8 kinds in one .flq

wav i24 8k + flac + aiff f32 + mp3 m1 + ogg + m4a + wav i16 + mp3 m1:
113.84 -> 79.11 MiB (**69.5%**, was 69.9%), 8/8 exact, refs saved 512 KB,
enc 102 s / 1.04 GiB, dec 7.0 s / 793 MiB.

## Random groups — N scaling (unrelated files, 60 MiB cap)

| N | vs singles | Enc | Dec peak heap |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | −6.79% | 1.3 s | 21 MiB |
| 4 | −0.005% | 2.5 s | 50 MiB |
| 8 | −1.38% | 7.3 s | 86 MiB |
| 16 | −3.89% | 26.1 s | 142 MiB |
| 31 | −1.71% | 45.8 s | 274 MiB |
| 39 | −5.39% | 54.6 s | 364 MiB |
| 36 | −4.85% | 35.9 s | 217 MiB |
| 37 | −2.58% | 53.4 s | 231 MiB |

N alone doesn't buy gain — unrelated files share nothing. Savings come from
self-repetition inside whichever WAVs the cap picked; variance across N is
sampling noise, not scaling. No group ever lost to its singles.
